title: Validity and Reliability in Measuring Biceps and Triceps by Using Ultrasound
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to estimate the validity and reliability in the measurement of bicep and tricep tendons and muscular morphologic characteristics by using ultrasound.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy male subjects
* Age range from 19-35 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of shoulder or elbow pain which needs medical treatment or surgery
